newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon central bank issues new auction details.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon central bank issues new auction details.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's details on Monday of the weekly Treasury bill auction showed heavy demand as yields continued to plunge .
The January 30 weekly auction raised 535.9 billion Lebanese pounds ($346.9 million) compared with 467.9 billion pounds the previous week, the finance ministry said.

The central bank said 60 percent of all competitive bids were accepted up to the discount rate and yield for three-month bills. But the acceptance rate was only 20 percent for six-month bills, 27 percent for 12-month bills and 25 percent for two-year bills.
"This means there was very heavy demand for the bills, and only those percentages of the demand were met," a trader said.
It was the first time the bank has issued these details of the weekly auction.
